1.explanation:
1. 'packages/react/src/components/Button/Button.js' is the main implementation file for the Button component. To add an expressive button variant (with 16px label and 48px height), this file will need to be updated to support the new size and style.
2. 'packages/react/src/components/OrderedList/OrderedList.js' and 'packages/react/src/components/UnorderedList/UnorderedList.js' are the main implementation files for the List components. To add an expressive list variant (using 16px type, 24px line height, $body-long-02), these files will need to be updated to support the new expressive style.
3. 'packages/type/src/styles.js' defines the typography tokens and their associated styles, including $body-long-02. To ensure the new expressive variants use the correct typography, this file may need to be referenced or updated if new tokens or mappings are required.
These files are key because they directly control the rendering and styling of the Button and List components, and the typography system that underpins their appearance.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario is about adding new 'expressive' variants for List and Button components in the Carbon Design System, to better support productive experiences on IBM.com. The current theme assumes most content is long-form or marketing, but many IBM.com experiences require more compact, productive UI elements. The request is to add expressive List (16px type, 24px line height, using $body-long-02) and expressive Button (16px label, 48px height) variants, and deprecate the 'expressive theme'. The provided images show the differences in typography and spacing between the current Carbon and the desired Digital/Expressive styles for both buttons and lists.
